description:
Find notes and daily logs and summarise thread activity; returns pointers and metadata, never document bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — find notes by thread, type, date range or text
  logs [--thread T] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — find daily logs by thread, date range or text
  activity [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a window
  overview THREAD [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread

Flags:
  notes: --thread thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; --type note type such as Meeting, case-insensitive; --text case-insensitive literal matched over topic and body; --limit max results, default 20, 0 for all; --since on or after YYYY-MM-DD; --until on or before YYYY-MM-DD; --json JSON output
  logs: same as notes minus --type; --text matches entry lines
  activity: --thread limit to one thread; --since, --until date bounds; --json
  overview: --limit recent items to list, default 5; --since, --until; --json

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--limit", "10"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--since", "2026-01-01", "--json"]
  ["activity", "--since", "2026-08-01", "--json"]
  ["overview", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]

Notes:
  Dates filter on the event date from frontmatter `timestamp`, not the file's capture date; the filename date is used only when frontmatter is missing or malformed.
  An unresolvable --thread or overview THREAD exits 1.
  Results are pointers; read the returned path to get the body.
